items.title: IDEX (IEX) Stock May Trade Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
items.summary: IDEX has logged a strong share price run over the past year, and that kind of move naturally raises a question for you as an investor. items.title: IDEX (IEX) Extends Its Dividend Record, Is The Valuation Discount Enough?
items.summary: Investors in IDEX (IEX) just received fresh income news. The Board approved a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.73 per share, marking the firm’s 129th consecutive quarterly payout and extending its dividend record. IDEX’s latest US$0.73 dividend update lands after a softer stretch for the shares, with the 7 day share price return down 4.63% and the 90 day share price return down 3.15%.
